scope: Public web functional code review, independent of the visual review

fixed.issue: Business prompt favorites and selected library view were never persisted
fixed.validation: Toggle a qualified favorite, change view, remount the actual App and verify both values

fixed.issue: Changing library page size or deleting the final favorite on a later page could leave an empty page
fixed.validation: Change from page 8 to table view; remove the thirteenth favorite while on page 2

fixed.issue: Business situations searched English IDs but excluded visible translated titles and descriptions
fixed.validation: Real EN/MK/SQ dictionaries, title and description queries, surrounding whitespace and unmatched query

fixed.issue: Business library startup and persistence could throw when browser storage was denied or full
fixed.validation: Render all three actual App bodies with storage reads and writes throwing

fixed.issue: Open Business prompt and agent readers did not follow hash Back navigation or canonical close destinations
fixed.validation: Select a card, return to library by hash history, close a card reader and close a direct-link reader

fixed.issue: Business backups accepted malformed draft JSON, invalid saved lists and unsupported preferences
fixed.validation: Reject malformed fields before restoring and preserve valid legacy IDs, unknown draft properties and recent records

fixed.issue: Legacy language/theme backups could be overridden by existing modern preference aliases
fixed.validation: Restore legacy aliases over conflicting modern aliases; inject a partial storage failure and verify rollback plus DEV isolation

fixed.issue: Business favorites could remain stale after another tab restored or reset saved work
fixed.validation: Use the real shared storage hook with focus/pageshow reset and restore events

fixed.issue: Agent and situation search controls lacked explicit accessible names
fixed.validation: Stable search input IDs, type search and real translated accessible labels

sourceIntegrity.content: All bundled Education and Business prompt, instruction and example fields
sourceIntegrity.method: Compare original and formatted block text after normalizing whitespace and structural list/heading markers

independentReview: Reviewed the shared storage hook and DEV latest-state commit/corrupt-data protection
Reported Builder unsaved-text replacement on theme-only synchronization; root agent fixed and added regression coverage
Reported cancelled Education resource navigation restoring a stale widget; root agent fixed request guard
Reported Business export accepting data rejected by restore; root agent added export validation
boundaries: This report records code and deterministic interaction tests; browser screenshots and viewport checks are recorded by the separate design review
No Android, mobile-prototype or AI Balkans source writes
No commit, push, tag or deployment
